text:
noah (AE): Quick thread: Meridian Health wants a 3-week POC next Wed. Asks: reserved pricing (monthly), throughput sizing for ~9k rps peak at ~650 tokens, and BYOK/HSM + 12mo logs.

lee (SE): they require predictable run-rate; finance won't accept burst-only. Also want AZ-eviction fallback.

tara (Solutions): initial recommendation: Dedicated eu-west-1, reserved pool = 4 GPUs (A30 equiv) with autoscale headroom to 6. Autoscale: min=4 target_util=0.65 max=6 cooldown=120s. Prewarm: KV warmup + synthetic ramp.

noah (AE): need short monthly cost bullets for 4 vs 6 vs 2+burst.

tara (Solutions): rough: 4 reserved ~ $30k/mo, 6 reserved ~ $43k/mo, 2+burst ~ $26k/mo but higher p99 risk. Will produce exact sheet. Note quantized runtime can give ~1.6x throughput; include quantized bin.

anya (Security): BYOK/HSM supported via partner HSM (enterprise add-on). Dedicated + enterprise pack supports 12mo logs. I'll draft answers for questionnaire.

ops_bot: created ticket SRV-9999 "Meridian POC: reserved plan + security pack" assigned to tara, due 2026-04-06.

lee (SE): Tara — please attach smoke test plan (0->9k rps ramp 15m), p50/p95/p99 capture, and token-cost per model variant.

tara (Solutions): will attach loadgen commands and latency/cost CSVs to SRV-9999. End of thread.
